records.header_literal: A) BSL v UKS (11.20 p.m., November 27th); 172- 2 TLE; 1 TL RIZI-238
records.readable_german: Bitte Station mit besonders guten Hoerern zu besetzen. Maessig schnell, deutliche Zeichen in Gruppenabstaenden zu senden. Da Funkstation
records.meaning: Staff the station with especially good listeners; transmit at a moderate speed with clear signs and spaces between groups. The sentence continues in part 2.
notes: The literal noncoordinate C in VXACX is masked, together with the two printed dashes; none is silently accepted as an ADFGVX coordinate.
The source ends VX- and contains the complete five-slot group VFVFD. Restoring these actually printed slots to the OCR record is not adding historical coordinates.

records.header_literal: A) same two-part telegram; 2 TL RICHI-176
records.readable_german: einziges, siceres Nachrichtenmittel mit Heimat. Welche stoerungsfreie Empfangswelle erwuenscht?
records.meaning: The radio station is described as the only secure communication link with home; the recipient is asked which interference-free receiving wavelength is desired.
notes: SICERES is retained exactly in the edited output and readable text. The intended word is plausibly [sicheres], but supplying H would add a plaintext position and is not claimed by this native-frame edition.
The two changed labels are Q to Z in EINQIGES and 6 to A in N6CHRICHTEN; the latter is a disclosed word repair, not a global reassignment of the square label 6.

records.header_literal: 26th NOVEMBER, 1918; B) UKS v ZON (07.51 a.m., November 26th); 0800; RICHI-92
records.meaning: A short report says there are no special events. Its apparent morning-report heading lacks a letter in this source-length reading; the field 17XJJ stays literal.
notes: MORENMELDUNG is retained, rather than silently lengthened to [Morgenmeldung]. The 92 source slots permit 46 plaintext positions, not 47.
The raw date-like field 17XJJ is not changed to match the printed 26 November heading. The two date layers are reported separately.

prior_credit: Published period keys: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). Earlier unreviewed repository candidates are preserved separately. This is a source edition and explicit repair review, not a claim of universal first-decipherment priority.
limits: All source slots are used in order; no missing group, inserted coordinate, deletion, swap or transposition change is proposed.
Digits and rare-letter labels remain literal; output agreement under a stated square does not establish historical numeral values.
Source-image comparison authenticates crop location and bytes, not the historical correctness of a proposed editorial word.
